title: satureja hydaspidis
intro: Satureja hydaspidis, commonly known as Creeping thyme or Zante thyme, is a low-growing, spreading herb native to the Greek island of Zakynthos. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, colds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Satureja hydaspidis include its ability to act as an antiseptic, astringent, and expectorant, making it a useful remedy for wound healing, sore throats, and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Satureja hydaspidis include thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
